params.body:
On the Reports page the failed list was folded, and the only way to open it was a small grey triangle at the far right of a row that read "4 failed" in small warm text. Easy to miss, on the list that most needs a person.

## What changes
- The list opens by itself when a report failed. Processing alone still starts folded.
- The count is a heading: base size, 600, `hot` when something failed (`warm` when only processing).
- The triangle is gone; "Show" / "Hide" (`Button` link, `aria-expanded`) sits next to the count.

## Tests
`e2e/reports-retry-search.spec.js`: the list is open on arrival, Hide and Show fold and unfold it; the other two tests pass unchanged. Brand ratchet ok, build ok.
params.title: Reports: the failed list opens by itself and folds with words
